title: [29.X]-Purchase invoice lines of type G/L Account where enabling 'Prices Including VAT' and changing the VAT Prod. Posting Group causes recalculation of the Direct Unit Cost Incl. VAT and Line Amount - Related to Bug  632380
summary: Adjusts Purchase Line handling for G/L Account purchase invoice lines with Prices Including VAT enabled, where changing the VAT Prod. Posting Group caused Direct Unit Cost Incl. VAT and Line Amount to be recalculated. Related tests were updated.
key_points: Targets G/L Account purchase lines with Prices Including VAT when the VAT Prod. Posting Group changes
One-line change in the Purchase Line table in every localization layer
Prices Incl. VAT document tests adjusted in W1 and ES
Linked to work item AB#649415 and related to bug 632380
